response.query: Which uncertainty quantification and calibration methods (ensembles, evidential learning, Monte Carlo dropout, temperature scaling) will we adopt and how will subgroup calibration be assessed?
response.answer: We will adopt Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensembles for uncertainty quantification, and use temperature scaling for calibration. Subgroup calibration will be assessed using Expected Calibration Error (ECE).
